cards.label: Stratford — a car park
cards.text: The buyer takes the pearl, turns it over once, and pays. Nobody mentions a knife. A woman walks past with a bag of shopping and doesn't look up.

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "That's it. That's the whole deal." He counts the cash into your hand. "Most of them are that boring. Remember it when they aren't."

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: He presses two more pearls into your palm. "Just in case. They go in your loadout, that's what you carry into a fight. Anything you want kept off the market goes in the stash."
